_how_to_add: Settings for the Videos section of the Gallery (assets/videos.js) and the videos on My journey. The YouTube videos and playlists themselves come from data/youtube.json, which agent/fetch_youtube.py rewrites every week from the channel below (see docs/MAINTAINING.md, Videos); until it exists, the Gallery lists the channel and the playlists in "playlists" (id, title, count), each played by YouTube's own player. "videos": videos that are not on the channel, such as a clip kept on the site ("src", an MP4 in assets/media/, and "poster") or a YouTube video of someone else's ("youtube": its id), each with title, kind, meta, date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, to place it among the others) and length (m:ss). "hide": YouTube video or playlist ids to leave out. "journey": videos or playlists to show on My journey, each at a stop named by its short name as on the timeline ("Amirkabir"), or year and short name when a name repeats ("2023 NASA"); after changing it, run python scripts/build_journey.py.
